name: Guinea Current
scope: Cape Palmas offshore approach to the Togo-Benin weakening transition near 2 E. Regional route convention, not the full Guinea Current extent. Excludes upstream equatorial countercurrent, Guinea Counter Current, Guinea Under Current, plume recirculation and eddy excursions.
layer: Near-surface regional geography; source describes Guinea Current in upper 50 m. No fixed-depth velocity core reconstructed.
time_convention: Summer regional convention informed by 2010-2017 model climatology and 1979-2019 drifter climatology; not a digitized seasonal mean axis or annual mean length.
source_locator: Results and Discussion, Surface Circulation and Subsurface Conditions; figures 1D-E and 2C. Model and Data documents simulation and drifter periods.
source_citation: Alory et al. (2021), Coastal Upwelling Limitation by Onshore Geostrophic Flow in the Gulf of Guinea Around the Niger River Plume, Frontiers in Marine Science 7, 607216, doi:10.3389/fmars.2020.607216. Published 8 January 2021.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects all offshore vertices, a Cape Palmas approach start and 2 E weakening-region gate. Alternative 1.5 E gate and coordinate offsets are editorial sensitivity choices, not observed endpoint bounds. Neither the coastal upwelling extent nor the Gulf boundary defines this current length.
scenario_rule: Two editorial eastern gate choices crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets: 54 scenarios, not statistical uncertainty.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Earlier editorial gate within weakening approach; not an observed current termination.

supporting_sources.citation: NOAA Tides and Currents glossary, Guinea Current.
supporting_sources.role: Named eastward regional flow identity only; no numerical endpoints.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 54 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
